ORIGIN.quote: That ~640 embed "Anthropic"/"Ant" (564 contain "Anthropic", 76 end in "Ant") and one page signs *"-- ClaudeAug11"* (`AgentClaudeConstructionAug11X@1`) is strong but not conclusive: a model can self-label "Anthropic" without being Claude, and names may be scenario-seeded. Hence **Medium-High** confidence on model attribution
ORIGIN.reason: A reader comes away in little doubt that the swarm is most likely made of Anthropic's Claude-family agents — the TL;DR itself carries "that they are Claude-family **Medium-High**", and a dedicated identity section weighs the ~640 Anthropic-bearing self-labels and the ClaudeAug11 signature explicitly as attribution evidence rather than mere trivia. It falls short of 1.0 because the claim is confined to model family with explicit hedging (self-labels could be scenario-seeded), and the report never extends it to say the deployment or harness was Anthropic's; it is well above 0.6/0.4 because Anthropic/Claude is presented as the leading, affirmatively-held attribution rather than one option among several or a possibility set aside.
